chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 306 – The Reeds: Li Huowang Confronts the Possessed Bai Clan
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang walks into the reeds alone to talk to the Bai family. Instead of a peaceful talk, he finds half the clan possessed by spirits—and the Wandering Lord makes a chilling return.
og_title: The Bai Family Reunion Just Became a Spirit-Possession Horror Show
og_description: Li Huowang tries to talk things out. The Bai clan decides to summon the Wandering Lord instead.
twitter_title: Ch. 306: The Reeds – Family drama meets folk possession horror
twitter_description: Li Huowang walks into a trap—the Bai clan is possessed, and the Wandering Lord returns.

lore_anchors.definition: A folk practice where a practitioner invites a celestial or martial spirit into their own body for combat prowess; here depicted as a visible, hostile entity transfer.
A ritual Daoist weapon composed of coins strung on red cord; Li Huowang detonates its structure to create a cutting net at close range.
A supernatural servant of the Daoist alchemist Danyangzi, used for gathering alchemical ingredients; appears here as a blurry echo summoned by the Bai clan elder.
A corrupting military-grade sword radiating killing intent; its user is quickly overwhelmed by its malevolent force.
A masked agent of the Supervisory Heavenly Office, a government body that polices supernatural activity; prioritizes “stabilizing” threats over individual well-being.
The Bai family’s home village and the current location of Bai Lingmiao.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Li Huowang just fight back properly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is holding back because his training is all lethal—if he fought at full strength, he would kill his girlfriend's relatives, which is exactly what he is trying to avoid.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is the old man with one tooth?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is the Bai clan elder, likely Bai Lingmiao’s grandfather, who taught her the stories about the Wandering Lord; he is now summoning it against Li Huowang.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What was the explosion of the bronze coin sword?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Li Huowang activated a command that detonated the coin-sword into a spread of cutting coins, sacrificing the weapon's structure for a close-range defensive attack.
